Pursuant to the resolution passed by the Board on August 08, 2026, the Company approved the Buyback of Company’s fully paid-up Equity Shares, at a buyback price not exceeding ₹ 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) per Equity Share (“Maximum Buyback Price”) from the shareholders/ beneficial owners of the Company (other than those who are Promoters, members of the Promoter Group and persons in control of the Company) (“Eligible Shareholders”) excluding Transaction Costs payable in cash for an aggregate amount not exceeding ₹ 697,000,000 (Rupees Six Hundred and Ninety Seven Million only) (hereinafter referred to as the “Maximum Buyback Size”), being 9.99% and 5.09% of the aggregate of the total paid-up Equity Share capital and free reserves of the Company based on the latest standalone and consolidated audited financial statements of the Company respectively, as at March 31, 2026 and which is not more than 10% of the total paid-up Equity Share capital and free reserves of the Company, whichever sets out a lower amount, in accordance with the proviso to Regulation 5(i)(b) of the Buyback Regulations and in accordance with the provisions contained in the Buyback Regulations and the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Buyback”). The Company commenced the Buyback on Friday, August 14, 2026, from the Eligible Shareholders from the Open Market through the Stock Exchanges mechanism under the Buyback Regulations. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited CS Pavan Kumar Jain Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Membership No. A66752 Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited A Key Milestone in Pipe Spooling Business Venus Pipes & Tubes receives Rs. 29 Crore Order Against Rs. 185 Crore LOI from Data Centre Customer for Pipe Spooling solutions Dhaneti, Gujarat – 30th October 2026 : Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd, one of the leading stainless- steel pipes / tubes manufacturers and exporters along with fittings in India announces today the receipt of order worth Rs. 29 crore for pipe spooling from a data centre customer, forming part of the Rs. 185 crore Letter of Intent (LOI) received earlier. The order follows the commencement of operations at a part of the Company’s dedicated pipe spooling manufacturing facility, which was commissioned ahead of the earlier planned timeline of December 2026. With production already underway, the Company is positioned to initiate execution and facilitate faster dispatch against the order. The balance value under the LOI is expected to be converted into firm orders in a phased manner. The Company plans to operationalise the remaining manufacturing capacity over the next few months to support the anticipated business. With increasing demand for end to end piping solutions, Company’s expansion into pipe spooling represents an opportunity to broaden its value-added product portfolio and strengthen its participation in emerging industrial segments. Commenting on the same, Arun Kothari, Managing Director, Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd, said, “The conversion of the LOI into a firm order marks an important step in translating the identified opportunity into business. We believe this order reflects the customer’s confidence in our capabilities and the growing demand for value-added piping solutions in the data centre infrastructure segment. We are encouraged by the opportunity and expect the balance value under the LOI to be converted into orders in a phased manner. Our pipe spooling capabilities will enable us to expand our value-added product portfolio, cater to evolving customer requirements and strengthen our presence across emerging industrial segments.” About Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd (https://www.venuspipes.com/; BSE: 543528; NSE: VENUSPIPES) Venus Pipes & Tubes Limited is a manufacturer and exporter of stainless-steel pipes and tubes. The company is into manufacturing of stainless steel tubes / pipes products along with fittings. Company manufactures pipes / tubes in two broad categories - seamless tubes/pipes and welded tubes/pipes under which five categories of products are manufactured namely, stainless steel high precision & heat exchanger tubes, stainless steel hydraulic & instrumentation tubes, stainless steel seamless pipes, stainless steel welded pipes and stainless-steel LSAW pipes. Bengaluru, India – October 30, 2026: Subex, a telecom AI company, today announced a significant new contract with an existing Tier-1 African telecommunications customer to deploy its AI Agent Squads for fraud alarm investigation and root cause analysis (RCA) within revenue assurance operations. QQ22 && HH11 FFYY2277 MAN INFRACONSTRUCTION LIMITED (CIN: L70200MH2002PLC136849) P R E S S R E L E A S E MICL GROUP DELIVERS STRONG Q2FY27 PERFORMANCE CONSOLIDATED PAT FOR Q2FY27 GROWS 14% YOY & H1FY27 GROWS 21% YOY” Mumbai, 29th October 2026: Man Infraconstruction Limited (MICL Group), one of Mumbai’s leading construction & real estate development companies, today announced its financial results for the quarter ended 30th Sep 2026. Manan Shah, Managing Director of Man Infraconstruction Limited said, “We have sustained the profitable growth momentum established at the start of FY27, with consolidated profit after tax after non-controlling interest increasing 14% YoY to ₹63 crores in Q2FY27 and 21% YoY to ₹134 crores in H1FY27. This performance reinforces our confidence in the business and our guidance of approximately 25% growth in PAT over FY26. Our portfolio is well positioned for the next phase of growth. Excluding projects newly launched during the financial year, our ongoing projects are approximately 65–70% sold and are expected to approach completion over the next 6–15 months. This would result in higher revenue recognition, profitability and cash flows going forward. During the quarter we announced an open-market buyback with a maximum size of ₹169 crores and have already completed 75.2% of the maximum approved size. We also achieved an important milestone in MICL’s journey after collaborating with Godrej Properties Group (Godrej) for the development of Marine Lines Project where we recouped our investments of ₹300+ crores and will continue to benefit through revenue sharing arrangement from the project.

No.: A39220 Encl: as above Registered Office: E-69, EPIP, Sitapura Industrial Area, Jaipur-302022, Rajasthan, India • Phone: +91-141-2770648; +91-141-2771975 CIN: L36911RJ1989PLC004945 • Email: investor_relations@vaibhavglobal.com • Website: www.vaibhavglobal.com PRESS RELEASE VGL Completes Platform Transition, Focuses on Restoring Digital Momentum and Improving Operating Leverage JAIPUR, India, 28 October 2026 -- Vaibhav Global Limited ("VGL") (NSE: VAIBHAVGBL; BSE: 532156), a vertically integrated electronic retailer of fashion jewellery, accessories and lifestyle products, today reported results for the second quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Mr. Sunil Agarwal, Managing Director, Vaibhav Global Limited, said:" Q2 FY27 was a quarter of transition as we completed the migration of our channel websites from Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Shopify Enterprise. During the stabilisation phase, temporary integration-related challenges, including customer account reactivation, optimisation of search and merchandising functionality, and SEO re-indexing, impacted digital conversion and revenue. In the UK, we also consolidated four warehouses and two studios into a single, larger headquarters. While the transition was completed smoothly, some inventory remains temporarily offline, limiting product availability and customer choice. Despite these near-term challenges, our European business delivered growth in constant currency, our B2B business recorded strong growth, and total revenue for the first half grew close to 10%. With the transition substantially behind us, we now have a unified, cloud-based and scalable platform supporting our brands and geographies. Our focus is on restoring digital momentum, strengthening customer acquisition and improving operating leverage as we enter our seasonally strongest quarters. We believe the new platform provides a stronger foundation for accelerating digital growth and driving sustainable, profitable growth in the periods ahead.,” • Revenue Growth: Revenue from operations increased 7.0% to ₹938.4 crore in Q2 FY27. H1 FY27 revenue grew 9.7% to ₹1,855.4 crore. • EBITDA Performance: Q2 FY27 EBITDA stood at ₹76.2 crore, with an EBITDA margin of 8.1%. H1 FY27 EBITDA increased 9.6% to ₹178.3 crore, with the margin of 9.6%. • United States: Q2 FY27 Revenue stood at ₹ 500.0 crore, increased by 4.3% in rupee terms and declined 4.1% in constant currency. • United Kingdom: Q2 FY27 Revenue stood at ₹257.2 crore increased by 2.3% in rupee terms and declined 7.0% in constant currency. • Europe (excluding UK): Q2 FY27 Revenue stood at ₹110.0 increased by 18.3% in rupee terms and 8.0% in constant currency. • B2B Business: Q2 FY27 Revenue stood at ₹70.9 crore grew 32.4%, while EBITDA stood at ₹ 42.4 crore increased 18.5% YoY • In-house Brands: In-house brands contributed 57% of B2C revenue. • Digital Business: eCommerce contributed 42.4% of B2C revenue, compared with

Dear Ma’am/Sir, In terms of Regulation 33(3) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), Videocon Industries Limited (the "Company") was obliged to submit and/or publish the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026 along with limited review report, on or before November 14, 2026. However, as the Company is not in a position to publish the said results in a timely manner, in compliance with the SEBI circular dated November 19, 2018, the Company would like to furnish the reasons for delay in publishing of financial results for the quarter and year ended on September 30, 2026 as under: 1. As you are aware, pursuant to an application filed before the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ("NCLT") by State Bank of India against the Company, under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 read with the rules and regulations framed thereunder, as amended from time to time ("IBC Code"), the NCLT, had vide its order dated June 06, 2018 admitted the application for the initiation of the corporate insolvency resolution process ("CIRP") of the Company in terms of the IBC Code. Subsequently, the Hon'ble NCLT vide its order dated August 08, 2019 ordered the consolidation of the CIRP of the 13 Videocon Group entities, including the Company, ("Videocon Group Entities"). Further, the NCLT vide an order dated September 25, 2019 had appointed Mr. Abhijit Guhathakurta as the resolution professional ("Resolution Professional") for the consolidated CIRP of the Videocon Group Entities including the Company ("Appointment Order"). The Appointment Order was published on September 27, VIDEOCON INDUSTRIES LIMITED Registered Office New Delhi Office Correspondence Address 14KM Stone, Aurangabad-Paithan Road, Videocon Tower, Eleventh Floor, Rani 171 Mittal Court, 17th Floor, ‘B- Wing’, Plot- Village Chittegaon, Taluka Paithan, District Jansi Marg, E-1 Jhandewa Ion Extn, New 224, Jamanalal Bajaj Marg, Nariman Point, Aurangabad – 431 105 India Delhi – 110055 India Mumbai, -400021 Email ID: secretarialvg.in@gmail.com www.videoconindustriesltd.com CIN: L99999MH1986PLC103624 2019, on which date the Resolution Professional took over the management and affairs of the Videocon Group Entities. Pursuant to the publication of the Appointment Order and in accordance with the provisions of the Code, the powers of the board of directors of the Company were suspended and the same were vested with and were being exercised by the Resolution Professional. 2. Q2 FY27 Consolidated Financial Performance Snapshot (Y-o-Y) The company reported Total Revenue of ₹ 147 crore, Gross Margin improved to 35%. Operating EBITDA stood at ₹ 35 crore, with EBITDA margin of 24%. Profit After Tax stood at ₹ 25 crores with PAT margin of 17%. H1 FY27 Consolidated Financial Performance Snapshot (Y-o-Y) The company reported Total Revenue of ₹ 296 crore, Gross Margin improved to 32%. Operating EBITDA stood at ₹ 63 crore, with EBITDA margin of 21%. Profit After Tax stood at ₹ 44 crores with PAT margin of 15%. Key Highlights: • Maintained a strong balance sheet with liquid cash balance of ₹ 119 Cr with gross debt of ₹ 56 Cr as at Sept 30, 2026, Net liquid cash balance of ₹ 63 Cr • Project pipeline comprises an estimated GDV of ₹ 19,000 Cr across approximately 5.7 million sq. ft. of saleable carpet area, providing strong growth visibility. • Successfully advanced business development initiatives through strategic land acquisitions across key micro-markets in Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). • The company continued to maintain its track record of timely project execution and delivery across ongoing developments. Commenting on the results, Mr. Amit Jain, Chairman and Managing Director, said: “We are pleased to report a healthy 22% year-on-year growth in collections during Q2 FY27, reflecting our continued focus on execution and disciplined project management. Vidit Aatrey, Chairman, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer at Meesho said, "Our Q2 performance reflects the strength of Meesho's operating model, with NMV growing 23% year-on-year to ₹12,911 crore and Annual Transacting Users reaching 284 million. More consumers are shopping on Meesho, and they are shopping more frequently, even as first-time buyers grew 16% quarter-on-quarter. This momentum extended into the festive season, with NMV growing 33% year-on-year on a festive-aligned basis, reinforcing our conviction in the depth of India's e-commerce opportunity. As we grow, the benefits of scale are increasingly translating into stronger platform economics. Contribution Margin expanded to 6.0% of NMV, driven by logistics efficiencies and improved monetisation. At the same time, AI is fundamentally changing how we build and operate Meesho, with engineering productivity increasing 171% between March and September 2026. Our focus remains on reinvesting these efficiency gains into better consumer and seller experiences, accelerating innovation and building a larger, more efficient marketplace that can generate sustainable free cash flow over the long term."
